vector_1_gauge_fixing.findings: For any fixed triple with B1=I, global phase rotation v -> exp(-i arg(v_0)) v strictly preserves mutual unbiasedness against all columns while pinning v_0 = 1/sqrt(6) real positive. The 5-torus candidate box [0.4082, 0.4083] x {0} x [-0.41, 0.41]^10 provably encloses all candidate vectors. Candidate basis columns can be independently phased without violating basis orthonormality or mutual unbiasedness.

vector_2_off_torus_cells.findings: Off-torus boxes are defined by 1/6 not in mod_sq interval for at least one coordinate. By the Intermediate Value Theorem on connected Cartesian product boxes, no point in any off-torus box can satisfy |v_k|^2 = 1/6. The count discrepancy (858,895 in point cover vs 954,386 in neighborhood cover) is caused by conservative interval widening forcing deeper splits, producing split off-torus children.

vector_3_boundaries.findings: split_widest produces closed intervals [lo, mid] and [mid, hi] overlapping at {mid}. Their union has zero gaps. Closed interval bounds guarantee that any point on the torus cannot be discarded by an off-torus neighbor.

vector_4_neighbourhood_widening.findings: EnclosedTriple::widened_from_exact_columns widens entrywise Cartesian coordinate intervals by +/- delta. In quantum mechanics, column/ray phasing yields the exact same physical MUB triple, but for theta = pi/6 the distance is > 0.12, exceeding delta = 1/1000. Widening does not quotient by column phase or basis rotation gauge symmetries.

vector_5_exactness.findings: d6_sos_float_sdp.rs is an isolated Stage B diagnostic with zero code paths leading to CoverCertificate. In cover_region_prefiltered, EnclosedTripleF64::residual_lower_estimate is strictly a performance heuristic; every certified box must pass exact.certify in exact BigRational arithmetic.

vector_6_merging.findings: merge_chunk_certificates does not validate expected chunk count (2^presplit = 64) or chunk indices. It returns complete: true even if 63 chunks are missing or 64 duplicates of chunk 0 are passed. Furthermore, merge_on_disk_presplit6_chunks returns any pre-merged summary on disk without validating the presence or hashes of the underlying 64 chunk files.
